headline: Bank of Korea Expected to Raise Benchmark Interest Rate to 3.25%
summary: The Bank of Korea is expected to raise its policy interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.25% at its upcoming meeting, responding to headline CPI remaining at 2.8% year-on-year.
why: The Bank of Korea sets South Korea's official monetary policy rates to balance inflation management with domestic economic growth.
